character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
16-bit pixel art baby sprite for a retro indie game, matching the exact same pixel-art style, pixel density, outlines, shading and proportions of the existing game assets.

Cute baby approximately 1 year old, small round head, short tiny hair, expressive eyes, chubby cheeks, small body, wearing a simple onesie and socks.

The baby is sitting normally on the floor, facing slightly toward the camera in a readable 2D side-view game perspective. Legs naturally positioned in front, hands relaxed beside the body, calm neutral happy expression.

Full body completely visible, centered sprite, clean readable silhouette, consistent pixel clusters, limited 16-bit color palette.

Transparent background. No furniture, no toys, no objects, no text, no shadows extending outside the sprite. Single baby only.
